spec.name: sprint24_qhour_open_momentum_majors
spec.hypothesis: Directional moves in the first 3 minutes after each 15-min quarter-hour boundary continue through the remainder of the block on BTCUSD/ETHUSD, driven by liquidity-clock/rebalancing flow.
spec.power_argument: 96 quarter-hour boundaries/day/symbol x 2 symbols x ~20-session test window = ~3840 candidate events; with a 0.15% trigger filter expect >=300 qualifying trades. Realized costs run ~9.6bps median (briefing NBBO recon), so set min detectable edge at 12bps net to require effects comparable in size to the taker_imbalance family results (11-29bps) and clear of cost noise at t>3.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
